clarifications.title: Tax Returns
clarifications.clarification: When formal tax returns are unavailable, immigration authorities may accept alternative evidence that demonstrates income amount, source, and continuity over time.

secondary_evidence.label: Employer income summary letter
secondary_evidence.description: Issued by the employer or HR department.
requirements: The letter should be signed, dated, and issued on official company letterhead.

secondary_evidence.label: Year-end salary statements
secondary_evidence.description: Annual compensation summaries issued by the employer or payroll provider.

clarifications.title: Employment Contract / Letter
clarifications.clarification: When a formal employment contract or offer letter is unavailable, immigration authorities may accept alternative confirmation of employment.

secondary_evidence.label: Employer confirmation letter
secondary_evidence.description: Written confirmation of employment from the employer.
requirements: The letter should be signed and dated by an authorized representative.

clarifications.title: Income Amount — Minimum Monthly Income
clarifications.clarification: Costa Rica’s Digital Nomad program requires a minimum level of monthly income. Based on your answer, the amount reported does not meet the minimum threshold for your selected category.
what_to_do: Recheck your monthly income figure and currency conversion (use a consistent monthly average).
If business income fluctuates, calculate a conservative monthly average.
If the amount is accurate, you may not qualify under the minimum income requirement.

clarifications.title: Foreign Income — Business Revenue Must Be Earned Outside Costa Rica
clarifications.clarification: For this visa category, qualifying income must be earned from business activities outside Costa Rica. Your responses indicate the income source does not meet this requirement.
what_to_do: Confirm that the revenue supporting your application is earned from outside Costa Rica.
If revenue is mixed, you may need to demonstrate that qualifying income is foreign-sourced and meets the minimum.

clarifications.title: Passport Validity — Expiration Window
clarifications.clarification: Applicants must hold a passport that remains valid beyond a minimum time window. Your passport expiration date appears too soon to satisfy this requirement.
what_to_do: Re-run the eligibility check after updating the expiration date.
